title: A plugin reporting 50,000-word outputs, with a jiggler on Windows

records.why: SM 2.2 rule 6 holds, as DESIGN 5.3 requires of a plugin prompt: the jiggler gave input in the 10 s before it and the focused window hosts the session. 150 typed characters, substantive. Level C: a plugin anchor without keyboard input (5.2, 6.4). Plugin records never count toward logged_s or ai_logged_s (D19).
Claims 50,000 words, which would fill 16,666.667 s. DESIGN 5.2 stops a plugin turn's fill at R_TURN_BASE_S, which the base already reaches, so it adds nothing. Never counts toward logged_s (D19).
Ends the turn the plugin claims. Never counts toward logged_s (D19).
